notice: Thresholds are derived from UI-PRMD Kinect motion capture, not from webcam clips, and are not a clinical judgment. A licensed physiotherapist must review and set appropriate values per patient before this is used for real feedback.
derived_from: UI-PRMD movement 9, Kinect FK positions, correct reps, derivation subjects only
scope_comment: peak_angle checks only the outward end of the movement (max rotation angle); src/rules.py is pinned and has no rule for the inward end.

target_peak_deg.comment: band [p5, 180] of peak_angle; p5 of peak_angle over 50 correct UI-PRMD m09 Kinect reps, subjects s01, s02, s03, s04, s05 (scripts/build_rotation_config.py)

tolerance_deg.comment: half-width of [p5, 180], +0.01 so 180 itself is inside after rounding

min_elbow_straight_deg.comment: Lower bound only: catches the elbow folding more than correct reps do. p5 of elbow_min over 50 correct UI-PRMD m09 Kinect reps, subjects s01, s02, s03, s04, s05 (scripts/build_rotation_config.py)

advisory_rules_comment: elbow_straight reports but does not count toward pass/fail -- the webcam elbow angle was found unstable (pre-registration Amendment 1).

max_trunk_lean_deg.comment: NOT data-derived: copied from shoulder_abduction.json. Trunk lean cannot be computed on UI-PRMD's Y-up FK positions.

tempo_min_s.comment: NOT data-derived: copied from shoulder_abduction.json. A [p5, p95] band of UI-PRMD segment durations was tried first and failed 43/50 held-out correct reps (each subject keeps their own pace; segments also include standing still). That choice was made after seeing held-out results, so the held-out tempo figures are not a clean test.

tempo_max_s.comment: NOT data-derived: copied from shoulder_abduction.json. A [p5, p95] band of UI-PRMD segment durations was tried first and failed 43/50 held-out correct reps (each subject keeps their own pace; segments also include standing still). That choice was made after seeing held-out results, so the held-out tempo figures are not a clean test.

cues.peak_angle: Rotate your forearm outward through the full range, keeping your elbow at your side.
cues.elbow_straight: Keep your elbow bent at about a right angle.
cues.trunk_lean: Keep your torso upright -- try not to lean or twist.
cues.tempo: Move at a steadier, more controlled pace.
cues.insufficient_data: Keep your whole arm, elbow and hand in view.
